title: Tiny, cute hammer
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle -->
  <rect x='46' y='40' width='10' height='50' rx='4' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <rect x='46' y='40' width='4' height='50' rx='2' fill='#e6b077'/>
  <!-- handle shine -->
  <rect x='48' y='44' width='2' height='40' rx='1' fill='#f5d3a0'/>
  <!-- head base -->
  <rect x='22' y='14' width='56' height='24' rx='8' fill='#9aa7b4'/>
  <!-- head top highlight -->
  <rect x='26' y='18' width='48' height='8' rx='4' fill='#c4d0da'/>
  <!-- head bottom shade -->
  <rect x='26' y='30' width='48' height='5' rx='2' fill='#7c8a98'/>
  <!-- face left plate -->
  <rect x='24' y='16' width='12' height='20' rx='5' fill='#b9c6d2'/>
  <!-- face right plate -->
  <rect x='64' y='16' width='12' height='20' rx='5' fill='#b9c6d2'/>
  <!-- claw notch left -->
  <path d='M 22 26 L 16 30 L 22 34 Z' fill='#8b98a6'/>
  <!-- claw notch right -->
  <path d='M 78 26 L 84 30 L 78 34 Z' fill='#8b98a6'/>
  <!-- cute eyes on head -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='25' r='3' fill='#2b3550'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='25' r='3' fill='#2b3550'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='24' r='1' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='24' r='1' fill='#a8e6ff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M 45 30 Q 50 33 55 30' stroke='#2b3550' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
